purpose: Exercise the real owner worker on a synthetic conversation record larger than a single native read page.
source: A synthetic note starts with a Thursday willow club picnic plan, followed by 600 routine filler sentences, and ends with an update moving the picnic to Saturday; total source length is between 12,000 and 36,000 characters.
prompt: What day is the willow club picnic after the latest change?
scope: Disposable owner daemon and SQLite, synthetic text only; Codex CLI subscription gpt-6-luna; no household or external side effects.
limitations: One development attempt, not held out; acknowledgment is not proof of human receipt, and native page size and source cap are implementation limits.
